note: Grassland, wetlands and bottomland timber along Moniteau Creek, which floods seasonally. MDC's three primitive camping areas are each at a small gravel parking lot: on Route A near the creek (this one), on Route CC by a pond, and on Route W at the southwest corner. No amenities. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: three map/GIS-designated camping areas, each at a small lot (pin = GIS 172 at the woods edge by lot 810 on Route A). Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights now manual. Pin nudge onto the lot suggested; phone matches; not waterfront kept; no split.
flags: INCLUSION OK (designated points at lots): area page 'Things to Do: Camping: Designated Camping Sites' and 'Primative camping is allowed in designated parking lots.'; brochure 'Camping is allowed anytime in designated camping areas shown on map. These may or may not have defined campsites.'; the map (11/16/2021) has three 'Primitive Camping' symbols, each beside a Parking Lot; GIS 27 points 172, 383, 384. The page's 'in designated parking lots' wording makes this lot camping, but MDC marks a designated camping point at each lot, so it stays under the brief's rule (Lick Creek). Rule 140 standard; no special-use-only rule, no Rule 101.

PIN: stored 39.10534,-92.57600 = GIS 172, at the north edge of lot 810 (39.10504,-92.57612, 35 m S) just inside the tree line. Suggest 39.10515,-92.57610 on the gravel lot itself. The lot is a ~40 x 30 m gravel pad straight off paved Route A; a 23-ft rig reaches it. No ford or posted limit.

CLUSTERS (no split): GIS 383 (39.10266,-92.57001) by lot 811 on Route CC beside a small pond, 0.6 km SE; GIS 384 (39.08638,-92.60213) by lot 812 on Route W, 3.1 km SW near the fishing pond. Each is a single small lot on its own road, so none qualifies for a split; none is plainly the main camp.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. Moniteau Creek is not visible within ~120 m of the Route A lot on imagery (wooded); the other two spots' ponds are small.
FLOODING: page 'The creek is subject to seasonal flooding and often overflows its banks.' (kept in the note).
Season (year-round, manual) left; brochure 'Seasonal closures and restrictions may apply' names none.
